content.user_title: Improve Agent Performance With Structured Tests
content.value_statement: Agent changes can regress quality when teams lack baselines and rollout checks. This skill guides measurable analysis, prompt improvements, A/B testing, staged deployment, and monitoring.
actual_capabilities: Defines baseline metrics for agent quality, speed, cost, and user satisfaction.
Classifies failures by instruction issues, context loss, tool misuse, and edge cases.
Suggests prompt improvements using examples, role refinement, self-checks, and output templates.
Outlines A/B testing with sample size, review methods, and success criteria.
Describes staged rollout, rollback triggers, monitoring, and post-deployment review.
limitations: Does not include executable scripts or automated test runners.
Requires existing metrics, feedback, or test cases to be useful.
Does not design a brand-new agent from scratch.
Requires environment-specific validation before production changes.

use_cases.title: Improve Support Agent Quality
use_cases.description: Analyze unresolved tickets, classify failures, update prompts, and track whether customer support responses improve after rollout.

use_cases.title: Harden Developer Assistant Behavior
use_cases.description: Review tool usage, context loss, format errors, and safety issues before changing a coding assistant prompt.

use_cases.title: Run Evaluation Rollouts
use_cases.description: Create A/B tests, human review rubrics, staged releases, rollback triggers, and monitoring for agent updates.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Baseline
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to evaluate [agent name]. Summarize current metrics, missing data, and the first three performance risks.

prompt_templates.title: Classify Failures
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze these failed interactions for [agent name]: [examples]. Group failures by root cause and recommend prompt changes with success metrics.

prompt_templates.title: Design an A/B Test
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an A/B evaluation plan for [original agent] and [improved agent]. Include sample size, metrics, human review, and decision criteria.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a Safe Rollout
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a staged rollout and monitoring plan for [improved agent]. Include rollback triggers, dashboard metrics, owner actions, and post-deployment review.

output_examples.input: Improve a customer support agent after unresolved tickets increased.
output: Baseline report with ticket resolution, correction rate, latency, and satisfaction metrics.
Failure categories that separate missing policy knowledge, unclear prompts, and weak escalation rules.
Prompt updates, test cases, and rollout criteria tied to measurable support outcomes.

output_examples.input: Compare a baseline coding assistant with a revised prompt.
output: A/B test plan with representative tasks, success metrics, sample size, and human review rubric.
Decision rules for shipping, revising, or rolling back the prompt change.
Monitoring checks for tool misuse, format errors, cost, and response latency.

output_examples.input: Prepare a production rollout for an improved research agent.
output: Staged release plan from internal testing through full deployment.
Rollback triggers for quality drops, safety violations, complaint spikes, and cost increases.
Post-deployment review plan for lessons learned and the next optimization cycle.

best_practices: Start with measurable baseline data before changing prompts or workflows.
Test improved agents against previous failures and common successful tasks.
Use staged rollout and rollback triggers for production agent changes.
anti_patterns: Changing prompts without regression tests or measurable success criteria.
Optimizing for a single example while ignoring broader user feedback.
Shipping an improved agent directly to all users without monitoring.

faq.question: What does this skill help improve?
faq.answer: It helps improve existing agent performance, reliability, prompt quality, tool usage, testing, rollout, and monitoring.

faq.question: Does this skill create new agents?
faq.answer: No. It is designed for improving agents that already have metrics, feedback, or test examples.

faq.question: What inputs work best?
faq.answer: Useful inputs include failed interactions, user feedback, baseline metrics, prompt versions, tool traces, and target success criteria.

faq.question: Can it help with A/B testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It outlines test sets, comparison metrics, human review, statistical checks, and deployment decisions.

faq.question: Does it run tests automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides planning guidance and evaluation structure, but users must run tests in their own environment.

faq.question: How does it reduce rollout risk?
faq.answer: It recommends staged deployment, rollback triggers, monitoring dashboards, and post-deployment review.
